source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U16: Apply financial-creditor initiation, default evidence and admission under the 2026 amendment

facts.statement: Section7 financialcreditor filing and evidence;application admission startsCIRP;class/allotteethresholdlower100or10%.

payload.title: A default allegation needs the filing record and decision
payload.core_explanation_md:
For the described financial-creditor route, the application must supply the applicable default evidence and proposed professional information. CIRP begins on admission, not on the bank first sending a demand. The 2026 amendment to section 7(5), read with the retrieved commencement notification, requires the stated order within fourteen days and identifies admission/rejection conditions, defect-cure notice and reasons for delay. It also clarifies the evidential role of the specified information-utility record.

Class-creditor and real-estate-allottee applications have their own joint-filing condition. Do not transfer a numerical threshold from the corporate-default rule into the separate number-of-applicants rule. Each application still needs the correct entity, date and statutory scope.

self_check.prompt_text: Is a demand letter itself the CIRP commencement order?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Commencement follows admission under the statutory route.

payload.stem_md: A bank counts the first demand date as CIRP commencement although no admission order exists. What is the proper distinction?

options.explanation_md: Demand, admission and liquidation are distinct events.

options.text_md: The claim amount alone establishes the admission date
options.explanation_md: An amount is not an order.

options.text_md: The applicant may select any convenient commencement date
The statutory process commences on admission, supported by the actual order
options.explanation_md: Filing or demand alone does not establish admission.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Filing or demand alone does not establish admission.

payload.stem_md: A legal note assumes all2026 amendments commenced solely because assent occurred. What evidence corrects that assumption?

options.explanation_md: It does not establish amendment commencement.

options.text_md: The amendment commencement clause and enumerated notification
options.explanation_md: Different provisions can have different commencement dates.

options.text_md: The bank internal update email alone
options.explanation_md: An internal email is not the operative notification.
A filename is not legal commencement evidence.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Different provisions can have different commencement dates.
